Title: 2025-10-06 Hotfix Patch
Subtitle: === Battlegrounds: Alterac Pass ===
CleanedNotes:
=== Battlegrounds: Alterac Pass ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Generals no longer provide Armor to nearby Heroes via A Call For Help.
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Gnoll Camps to spawn 30 seconds later than intended.

=== Battlegrounds: Braxis Holdout ===
[Updates]
  Objective:
  • Zergs
    • Zerglings
      • [Undocumented] Baseline amount increased from 4 to 6.
    • Ultralisks
      • [Undocumented] Health reduced from 4700 to 3800.
      • [Undocumented] Health scaling for minutes 1-5 reduced from 235 to 190.
      • [Undocumented] Health scaling for minutes 6-10 reduced from 325.5 to 285.
      • [Undocumented] Health scaling for minutes 11-16 reduced from 470 to 380.
      • [Undocumented] Health scaling for minutes 17-30 reduced from 587.5 to 475.

=== Battlegrounds: Hanamura Temple ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Recon Camps to spawn 30 seconds later than intended.

=== Battlegrounds: Volskaya Foundry ===
[Updates]
  Objective:
  • Control Points
    • [Undocumented] Activation time reduced from 6 to 3 seconds.
    • [Undocumented] Deactivation time increased from 6 to 12 seconds.
    • [Undocumented] Time required for 100% progress reduced from 52 to 45 seconds.

=== Battlegrounds: Warhead Junction ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Warheads to deal less percent damage to Structures than intended with the initial impact.
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Warheads to ignite Structures for longer than intended after impacting on them.
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Warheads to set the ignite duration on Structures higher than intended after Heroic Basic Attacks.

=== Heroes: Diablo ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] The heal from Diablo's Life Leech now occurs before it grants 1 Soul instead of after it.

=== Heroes: Kael'thas ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing some Kael'thas's Talents to not register the first time they hit an enemy Hero.

=== Heroes: Lúcio ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] The simple tooltip for Lúcio's Party Mix now mentions radius instead of range.

=== Heroes: Nazeebo ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Basic Attacks from Nazeebo's Gargantuan to not deal damage.

=== Heroes: The Butcher ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] The Butcher's Brutal Strike now displays as a critical hit.

=== Heroes: Uther ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Uther's Holy Fire to not display correctly in the Buff Bar.
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing the tooltip for Uther's Benediction to display its cooldown incorrectly.
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing the tooltip for Uther's Hand of Freedom to display its cooldown reduction incorrectly.

=== Heroes: Valla ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Valla's Fire At Will to give bonus Hatred without the Talent being taken.
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Valla's Fire At Will to not display the amount of bonus Hatred correctly.

=== Heroes: Zagara ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Zagara's Hydralisk Tranfusion to heal her twice.
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing the tooltip for Zagara's Hunter Killer to not display its damage correctly.
  • [Undocumented] The tooltip for Zagara's Hunter Killer now mentions the Hydralisk's Health.
  • [Undocumented] The tooltip for Zagara's Mutalisk now mentions the Mutalisk's Health.

=== Heroes: Zarya ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Deep Burn's tooltip to display Zarya's Energy gained per Basic Attack incorrectly.
